metadata.flysyria:note: Shared basemap style for the native app (MapLibre). The web map is Leaflet and cannot read this file — it renders the same CARTO raster tiles and the same Syria polygon through its own API, so the two match by using identical sources rather than by sharing a renderer. Keep the tile URLs and the #4a7a30 boundary styling in step with components/Map.tsx if either changes.
metadata.flysyria:raster-not-vector: Raster rather than CARTO's vector basemap, deliberately. Vector would look crisper and rotate properly, but it is a different renderer with a different look and needs a CARTO account. These are the exact tiles the web map already draws, so the basemap is identical by construction.
metadata.flysyria:no-glyphs-or-sprite: Neither is declared: nothing in this style renders text or icons. Aircraft symbols are added at runtime by the app, which registers its own images.
